rationale: Building each pin in isolation and calling its own compiled extractApprovedPaths, codex a82456a5 was the only implementation that kept reuse citations out of approvedPaths in every shape tested — reuse section last, a literal z in the body, a nested ### subheading, two alias sections, and a lowercase heading — where cursor a56990ab leaks in the first four (its \z is an identity escape, not an anchor) and my own pin 225c476b leaks in the nested-subheading and lowercase cases; codex's only defect is that a depth-1 '# Reuse and Scope' swallows the sections after it, which fails closed and is a one-comparison fix.
